questions.question: Which company had the highest revenue in fiscal 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT c.name, f.revenue FROM companies AS c JOIN financials AS f USING (ticker) WHERE f.fiscal_year = 2023 ORDER BY f.revenue DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What was Apple's revenue in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT f.revenue FROM financials AS f JOIN companies AS c USING (ticker) WHERE c.ticker = 'AAPL' AND f.fiscal_year = 2023

questions.question: What was Microsoft's net income in 2022?
questions.sql: SELECT net_income FROM financials WHERE ticker = 'MSFT' AND fiscal_year = 2022

questions.question: Which company had the highest net margin in 2024?
questions.sql: SELECT c.ticker, c.name FROM companies AS c JOIN ratios AS r USING (ticker) WHERE r.fiscal_year = 2024 ORDER BY r.net_margin DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which sector had the highest average net margin in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT c.sector FROM companies AS c JOIN ratios AS r USING (ticker) WHERE r.fiscal_year = 2023 GROUP BY c.sector ORDER BY AVG(r.net_margin) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many companies had revenue above 100 billion dollars in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM companies AS c JOIN financials AS f USING (ticker) WHERE f.fiscal_year = 2023 AND f.revenue > 100000000000

questions.question: Which company had the largest total assets in 2024?
questions.sql: SELECT c.ticker, c.name, f.total_assets FROM companies AS c JOIN financials AS f USING (ticker) WHERE f.fiscal_year = 2024 AND NOT f.total_assets IS NULL ORDER BY f.total_assets DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which company had the smallest total assets in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT c.ticker, c.name, f.total_assets FROM companies AS c JOIN financials AS f USING (ticker) WHERE f.fiscal_year = 2023 AND NOT f.total_assets IS NULL ORDER BY f.total_assets ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which company generated the most operating cash flow in 2024?
questions.sql: SELECT c.ticker, c.name, f.operating_cash_flow FROM companies AS c JOIN financials AS f USING (ticker) WHERE f.fiscal_year = 2024 AND NOT f.operating_cash_flow IS NULL ORDER BY f.operating_cash_flow DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What was Apple's revenue growth from 2023 to 2024, in percent?
questions.sql: WITH aapl_rev AS (SELECT f.fiscal_year, f.revenue FROM financials AS f JOIN companies AS c USING (ticker) WHERE c.ticker = 'AAPL' AND f.fiscal_year IN (2023, 2024)) SELECT ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2024 THEN revenue END) / MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2023 THEN revenue END) - 1) * 100, 1) AS revenue_growth_percent FROM aapl_rev

questions.question: Which company had the highest revenue growth from 2022 to 2023, in percent?
questions.sql: WITH rev22 AS (SELECT ticker, revenue FROM financials WHERE fiscal_year = 2022), rev23 AS (SELECT ticker, revenue FROM financials WHERE fiscal_year = 2023) SELECT c.name, ROUND(((r23.revenue / r22.revenue - 1) * 100), 1) AS revenue_growth_percent FROM rev22 AS r22 JOIN rev23 AS r23 USING (ticker) JOIN companies AS c USING (ticker) WHERE NOT r22.revenue IS NULL AND NOT r23.revenue IS NULL ORDER BY revenue_growth_percent DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which companies had lower net income in 2023 than in 2022?
questions.sql: WITH f22 AS (SELECT ticker, net_income FROM financials WHERE fiscal_year = 2022), f23 AS (SELECT ticker, net_income FROM financials WHERE fiscal_year = 2023) SELECT c.ticker, c.name FROM companies AS c JOIN f22 ON c.ticker = f22.ticker JOIN f23 ON c.ticker = f23.ticker WHERE f23.net_income < f22.net_income ORDER BY c.ticker

questions.question: What was the total revenue of the Technology sector in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(f.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM companies AS c JOIN financials AS f USING (ticker) WHERE c.sector = 'Technology' AND f.fiscal_year = 2023

questions.question: What was the average revenue of Healthcare companies in 2022?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(f.revenue) AS average_revenue FROM companies AS c JOIN financials AS f USING (ticker) WHERE c.sector = 'Healthcare' AND f.fiscal_year = 2022

questions.question: Which companies have no operating income values in this dataset?
questions.sql: SELECT c.ticker, c.name FROM companies AS c JOIN financials AS f USING (ticker) GROUP BY c.ticker, c.name HAVING COUNT(f.operating_income) = 0 ORDER BY c.ticker

questions.question: What was Johnson & Johnson's pretax margin in 2023, in percent?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(r.pretax_margin * 100, 1) AS pretax_margin_percent FROM companies AS c JOIN ratios AS r USING (ticker) WHERE c.name = 'Johnson & Johnson' AND r.fiscal_year = 2023

questions.question: What was Coca-Cola's ratio of operating cash flow to net income in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT f.operating_cash_flow / f.net_income AS operating_cash_flow_to_net_income FROM financials AS f JOIN companies AS c USING (ticker) WHERE c.ticker = 'KO' AND f.fiscal_year = 2023

questions.question: Which company had the highest net income in 2021?
questions.sql: SELECT c.ticker, c.name FROM companies AS c JOIN financials AS f USING (ticker) WHERE f.fiscal_year = 2021 AND NOT f.net_income IS NULL ORDER BY f.net_income DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many fiscal years of data do we have for Walmart?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year) AS fiscal_years FROM financials WHERE ticker = 'WMT'
